promotion.method: Exact byte copies after coding-agent inspection of all six staged pictures beside their corresponding HSR trumpet references. This artwork review does not create a human game observation.
promotion.relocation: staged_to_canonical records the exact original and canonical basenames; all PNG bytes remain unchanged.
promotion.private_path_redaction: None required; reports contain portable relative paths.

visual_review.method: Each of the six staged images was inspected beside the corresponding HSR trumpet image in a paired review sheet.
visual_review.scope: View order, title and purpose rows, north-up and opposite angled cameras, XY tile grid, compass, full component-name panels, placement badges, leader colours, and filled ownership cells match the shared presentation contract.
visual_review.limit: The lower deck and some pavement are physically occluded by retained upper-deck geometry. Software artwork does not verify in-game appearance, lighting, or filtering.
